definitions.explanation: An organic compound that serves as a building block of proteins. Commonly encountered in contexts such as nutrition, health foods, supplements, cosmetics, and biology. Twenty amino acids make up the proteins of the human body, and a subset ({必須|ひっす}アミノ{酸|さん}) must be obtained from food.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧アミノ{酸|さん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: Meat contains a lot of amino acids.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦シャンプー→シャンプー：04507_shanpuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧アミノ{酸|さん}⟦{系|けい}→〜系：28466_kei⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧やさしい。
examples.english: This shampoo is amino-acid-based, so it's gentle on the hair.

examples.japanese: {運動後|うんどうご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧アミノ{酸|さん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{摂取|せっしゅ}→摂取：09322_sesshu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that taking amino acids after exercise speeds up recovery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧20⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧アミノ{酸|さん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{作|つく}られる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な⟦タンパク{質|しつ}→タンパク質：08817_tanpakushitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{構成|こうせい}→構成：02729_kousei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The human body is made up of various proteins built from about twenty kinds of amino acids.

notes:
Loanword compound: the katakana stem アミノ (from 'amino') + the kanji ⟦{酸|さん}→酸：28620_san⟧ ('acid'). The katakana portion is a scientific borrowing, and the Japanese word always mixes katakana with the kanji ending.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{必須|ひっす}→必須：12516_hissu⟧アミノ{酸|さん}: essential amino acid
- {非必須|ひひっす}アミノ{酸|さん}: non-essential amino acid
- {遊離|ゆうり}アミノ{酸|さん}: free amino acid
- アミノ{酸|さん}⟦{飲料|いんりょう}→飲料：03011_inryou⟧: amino acid drink (sports drink)
- アミノ{酸|さん}⟦サプリメント→サプリメント：10937_sapurimento⟧: amino acid supplement
- アミノ{酸|さん}⟦{系|けい}→〜系：28466_kei⟧⟦シャンプー→シャンプー：04507_shanpuu⟧: amino-acid-based shampoo
- アミノ{酸|さん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{摂取|せっしゅ}→摂取：09322_sesshu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take in amino acids
- アミノ{酸|さん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧: rich in amino acids

USAGE:
- A fully naturalized scientific term that appears frequently on food labels, supplement ads, and cosmetics packaging. In advertising copy, it often implies 'natural' or 'body-friendly.'
- In the food industry it is strongly associated with ⟦{旨味|うまみ}→旨味：06998_umami⟧ ('savoriness'), since glutamic acid (グルタミン⟦{酸|さん}→酸：28620_san⟧) is the amino acid most responsible for umami taste.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦タンパク{質|しつ}→タンパク質：08817_tanpakushitsu⟧ / 蛋白{質|しつ}: protein — the macromolecule built from chains of amino acids.
- ⟦{酸|さん}→酸：28620_san⟧: acid — the general chemistry term.
- アミノ{酸|さん}⟦{配列|はいれつ}→配列：14447_hairetsu⟧: amino acid sequence — biological/genetics term.
- ⟦{旨味|うまみ}→旨味：06998_umami⟧: umami — the savory taste produced by certain amino acids such as glutamic acid.
